offerings.name: Search Atlas
offerings.description: Search Atlas is the agentic AI marketing platform that runs your SEO, ads, content, and site health on its own, then fixes what breaks before you wake up.

offerings.name: AI Content Templates
offerings.description: AI Content Templates is a modular AI generation feature that produces optimized marketing copy across multiple channels (SEO, email, social, ads) using structured prompt engineering and semantic intent modeling.

offerings.name: Atlas Brain
offerings.description: Atlas Brain is the conversational AI SEO agent inside Search Atlas. It reports and executes full SEO strategies from a single conversational interface, rather than stopping at recommendations.

offerings.name: Atlas Coworker
offerings.description: Atlas Coworker is Search Atlas's workspace integration layer. It brings Atlas Agent capabilities into the messaging and project management tools where marketing teams already work: Slack, Microsoft Teams, and ClickUp.

offerings.name: Backlink Gap Analysis
offerings.description: Backlink Gap Analysis (also called Link Gap Analysis Tool) is an AI competitive link intelligence system that identifies domains linking to competitors but not to the target site. Compares up to 6 domains.

offerings.name: Backlink Profile Comparison
offerings.description: Backlink Profile Comparison Tool is a competitive SEO analytics system that compares backlink metrics across 2 to 6 domains and quantifies link equity distribution.

offerings.name: Backlink Research
offerings.description: Backlink Research is a link intelligence dashboard that evaluates the authority, quality, and trajectory of a domain's backlink profile.

offerings.name: Bulk URL Analyzer
offerings.description: Bulk URL Analyzer (Free DA Checker) is a Search Atlas feature that measures Domain Authority and Page Authority across multiple domains in one operation.

offerings.name: Content Genius
offerings.description: Content Genius is an AI-based content editor that engineers SEO copy through semantic, structural, and intent modeling. Applies NLP, entity recognition, and contextual clustering.

offerings.name: Content Pruning Tool
offerings.description: Content Pruning Tool is an AI-powered content evaluation engine that identifies low-quality, thin, outdated, or underperforming pages across a domain.

offerings.name: Content Rewriting
offerings.description: Content Rewriting (Content Rewriter Quick Tool) is an AI-based linguistic transformation feature in Search Atlas that reconstructs existing text through controlled tone, syntactic variation, and semantic accuracy.

offerings.name: Content Velocity
offerings.description: Content Velocity is an AI-powered publication analysis engine that tracks publishing patterns, sitemap output, and competitive velocity.

offerings.name: Crawl Monitoring
offerings.description: Crawl Monitoring is an AI-powered crawler intelligence engine that tracks real-time bot activity across a site.

offerings.name: Domain Power
offerings.description: Domain Power is a proprietary 100-point logarithmic authority metric developed in Search Atlas. Measures true organic visibility and competitive strength by integrating organic traffic, keyword performance, and ranking distribution across the top 100 SERPs.

offerings.name: GBP Galactic
offerings.description: GBP Galactic (Google Business Profile Galactic) is an AI local SEO automation system inside Search Atlas that manages, optimizes, and scales Google Business Profiles across multiple locations.

offerings.name: GSC Performance
offerings.description: GSC Performance Tool is an integrated analytics environment inside Search Atlas that visualizes keyword rankings, traffic fluctuations, and page performance through synchronized Google Search Console (GSC) and Google Analytics 4 (GA4) data.

offerings.name: Keyword Gap Tool
offerings.description: Keyword Gap Tool is a competitive analysis feature that uncovers keywords competitors rank for but the target domain does not capture. Compares up to 6 domains side by side.

offerings.name: Keyword Magic Tool
offerings.description: Keyword Magic Tool is an AI keyword expansion engine in Search Atlas that accelerates keyword discovery through semantic analysis.

offerings.name: Keyword Rank Tracker
offerings.description: Keyword Rank Tracker (KRT) is a ranking intelligence module in Search Atlas that measures keyword visibility, device segmentation, and geographic performance for tracked domains and pages.

offerings.name: Keyword Research Tool
offerings.description: Keyword Research in Search Atlas is an AI-augmented SEO and PPC keyword intelligence system that analyzes keyword performance, intent, and competition.

offerings.name: Link Building Outreach and Digital PR Tool
offerings.description: Link Building Outreach and Digital PR Tool is an outreach automation system inside Search Atlas that centralizes email sequencing, follow-up scheduling, response tracking, link prospecting, and media pitching. Replaces disjointed workflows across CRMs, spreadsheets, and inboxes.

offerings.name: LLM Visibility Tool
offerings.description: LLM Visibility Tool is an AI-powered brand visibility engine in Search Atlas that identifies brand mentions, tracks sentiment shifts, and uncovers visibility gaps across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity.

offerings.name: Local Citation Builder
offerings.description: Local Citation Builder is a local SEO feature that automates the distribution and optimization of business data across verified citation networks. Enforces NAP (Name, Address, Phone) accuracy.

offerings.name: Local SEO Heatmaps
offerings.description: Local SEO Heatmaps visualize the organic visibility of a business across geographic areas by tracking Google Map Pack rankings for specific keywords and service regions.

offerings.name: Meta Generator
offerings.description: Meta Generator is an AI metadata generation tool that constructs optimized meta titles, descriptions, and tags through semantic weighting, keyword intent modeling, and entity correlation.

offerings.name: On-page Audit Tool
offerings.description: Onpage Audit Tool is an AI-powered on-page optimization engine that evaluates authority, content quality, technical signals, and user experience.

offerings.name: OTTO SEO
offerings.description: OTTO SEO is an AI autopilot SEO agent that deploys live page modifications through a single JavaScript pixel across any CMS. Modifies structure, metadata, schema, content, and internal links in real time.

offerings.name: Portfolio Summary
offerings.description: Portfolio Summary is an AI-powered multi-account performance engine that generates unified scoring across connected accounts.

offerings.name: Press Release Distribution Software
offerings.description: Press Release Distribution is an AI-powered press release engine that automates drafting, optimization, and syndication of announcements.

offerings.name: QUEST
offerings.description: QUEST is an AI-powered LLM visibility engine in Search Atlas that identifies which documents LLMs reference, reveals influence pathways, and uncovers visibility gaps.

offerings.name: Report Builder
offerings.description: Report Builder is an AI-augmented reporting engine that consolidates SEO, content, LLM visibility, and analytics data into unified dashboards and client-ready reports.

offerings.name: Schema Markup Generator
offerings.description: Schema Markup Generator creates structured data in JSON-LD format (JavaScript Object Notation for Linked Data) for pages including blogs, products, and business listings.

offerings.name: SCHOLAR
offerings.description: SCHOLAR (Semantic Content Heuristics for Objective Language Assessment and Review) is a proprietary semantic evaluation system inside Search Atlas that measures factual precision, linguistic clarity, and information value in SEO content.

offerings.name: Search Atlas Platform
offerings.description: Search Atlas is an AI-powered digital marketing platform that centralizes SEO, GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), and LLM Visibility functions in one system. Powered by OTTO, its proprietary execution engine.

offerings.name: SEO White-Label Software
offerings.description: SEO White-Label Software is a fully customizable reporting and platform branding system that lets agencies, consultants, and enterprises deliver client-facing SEO services under their own brand identity.

offerings.name: Site Auditor
offerings.description: Site Auditor is a technical SEO crawler that performs full-domain analysis to identify, classify, and quantify on-page and structural issues across web properties.

offerings.name: Site Explorer
offerings.description: Site Explorer is an enterprise-level SEO intelligence platform inside Search Atlas that performs domain-level, subdomain-level, and URL-level analysis across organic, paid, and backlink datasets.

offerings.name: Smart Ads
offerings.description: Smart Ads is an AI PPC automation system that builds, optimizes, and manages Google Ads campaigns inside the Search Atlas dashboard. Powered by Atlas Brain, Smart Ads translates goals into campaign actions, reallocates budget to what converts, and deploys optimizations directly inside live campaigns. Previously named O

offerings.name: Topical Dominance
offerings.description: Topical Dominance is a Site Explorer feature inside Search Atlas that measures authority and visibility of a domain across defined topic clusters.

offerings.name: Topical Map Generator
offerings.description: Topical Map Generator is a semantic clustering tool in Search Atlas that builds topic-based SEO roadmaps using entity relationships, keyword hierarchies, and long-tail search intent analysis.

offerings.name: Universal Email Alerts
offerings.description: Universal Email Alerts deliver real-time automated notifications that track performance changes, technical issues, and ranking movements across all connected projects in Search Atlas.

offerings.name: URL Indexer
offerings.description: URL Indexer is an AI-assisted indexing accelerator that speeds up search engine discovery through rapid submission workflows.

offerings.name: Website Studio
offerings.description: Website Studio is an AI Landing Page Builder inside Search Atlas that generates complete, conversion-ready landing pages from a single prompt. Pages are created, structured, and published with SEO-ready architecture, conversion sections, tracking, form capture, and CDN delivery in place.

offerings.name: WILDFIRE
offerings.description: WILDFIRE (Websites Inter-Linking Directly Fostering Influence, Reputation, and Engagement) is an automated backlink exchange network developed by Search Atlas. Generates inbound links through verified topical relationships and real-time authority validation.

offerings.name: Search Atlas Features: The AI That Runs Your Marketing
offerings.description: Search Atlas runs SEO, AEO, Google and Meta Ads, content, and local on its own, and fixes what breaks. See every capability and compare plans.
